spec.prompt: The camelCase alias fastify-plugin derives from a plugin name isn't always a valid identifier: 'my--plugin' gives 'my-plugin', 'plugin-' stays 'plugin-', and '@a/b/c-d' gives 'aB/cD'. Fix lib/toCamelCase.js so hyphens and slashes never survive: drop a leading '@', split the rest on runs of '-' and '/', ignore empty pieces, keep the first piece as is and upper-case only the first character of each following piece. So 'my--plugin' → 'myPlugin', 'plugin-' → 'plugin', '@a/b/c-d' → 'aBCD', '@scope/my-plugin' → 'scopeMyPlugin', 'fooBar-baz' → 'fooBarBaz', 'my_plugin' → 'my_plugin'. The alias fp sets on the plugin follows the same rule.
spec.requirement: toCamelCase(name) drops a leading '@', splits the rest on runs of '-' and '/', ignores empty pieces, keeps the first piece as is and upper-cases the first character of each following piece (other characters unchanged). Examples: '@scope/my-plugin' → 'scopeMyPlugin', 'my--plugin' → 'myPlugin', 'plugin-' → 'plugin', '@a/b/c-d' → 'aBCD', 'fooBar-baz' → 'fooBarBaz', 'my_plugin' → 'my_plugin'. The alias fp sets (fn[camelName]) follows the same rule.
spec.adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.
